##: Generated for Tessera's GitHub releases. Update 'version', 'url' and 'hash' from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt when a new tag ships.
description: One search bar for everything your PC can't search — images, screenshots, PDFs, and documents — offline, free, and open source.
notes: The first launch downloads the search models once (about 1.3 GB), checksum-pinned; after that Tessera never touches the network at query time.
Scoop installs the app but not the autostart entry — enable 'Start Tessera when I sign in' in Settings.
